Tacrolimus oliguria is not the same drug-specific objective as cyclosporine-associated hyperkalemia; both are calcineurin inhibitor safety, but different measured manifestation and drugs.
Metabolic alkalosis caused by gastric suction differs from compensated respiratory alkalosis in asthma and their laboratory analysis.
Asthma associated respiratory alkalosis contrasts with NG suction metabolic alkalosis.
Q157 addresses respiratory failure intervention with acidemia/hypercapnia, not the metabolic alkalosis of gastric suction.
Q072 assesses respiratory alkalosis; Q157 assesses deteriorating gas exchange and respiratory support.
Q073 addresses NG loss alkalosis; Q157 analyzes failure and respiratory treatment.
